lecture_weeks.topic_raw: Classic problems in static program analysis, monotone data flow framework including lattice concepts, control flow graph, pointer analysis, analysis with Soot.
lecture_weeks.tutorial: A programming assignment to implement basic dataflow analyses using Soot.

lecture_weeks.topic_raw: Introduction to advanced topics including interprocedural analysis and symbolic execution.
lecture_weeks.tutorial: A programming assignment involving an implementation of a simple interprocedural dataflow analysis using Soot. Another assignment will involve using a symbolic execution tool to generate test cases.

lecture_weeks.topic_raw: Runtime monitoring concepts, finite state properties, aspects, security automata.
lecture_weeks.tutorial: A programming assignment to implement runtime monitors using aspects.
